warp.bot: Find-or-create a contact by name, email, or phone. Extract whatever info is available — at least a name; prefer email and phone when known. If a match is returned, do not create another contact — use contact update for non-empty field changes. To set a profile image, upload media first (media_upload) then pass the media ID in avatar as a JSON array. On an existing match, avatar is only set if the contact has none yet.

warp.bot: Help the user update a contact's details. If the user refers to a contact by name, list contacts first to find the matching ID. If the user mentions waiting on something from the contact (a response, document, or decision), set nextFollowUpAt to the date they should be chased by and followUpNote to what is awaited. Use null to clear an existing follow-up. To set a profile image, upload media first (media_upload) then pass the media ID in avatar as a JSON array (e.g. ["mediaId"]). Pass [] to clear the avatar.
